2609.11211.title: X-RACE: XAI-assisted Recurrent neural network Attribution for Channel Estimation
2609.11211.paper_summary: Deep learning models, notably Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), have demonstrated promising performance in channel estimation for high-mobility vehicular environments. However, their black-box nature and architectural overhead limit trustworthiness and efficiency. Classical explainable AI (XAI) methods rely on costly iterative processes, offering only input-level filtering without addressing architectural fine-tuning. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes the XAI-assisted Recurrent neural network Attribution for Channel Estimation (X-RACE) framework. X-RACE uses a low-complexity, one-shot dual-optimization strategy to simultaneously evaluate and prune irrelevant input subcarriers and internal hidden units. Furthermore, we propose novel temporal XAI metrics: Saturation Time, Importance Drift, and Relevance Contrast to characterize the LSTM's learning dynamics and memory convergence. Extensive simulations demonstrate that X-RACE reduces inference complexity by at least 44.1% while improving or preserving Bit Error Rate (BER) performance, outperforming classical XAI schemes.
2609.11211.paper_summary_zh: 深度學習模型，特別是長短期記憶（LSTM），在高移動性車輛環境的通道估計中顯示出良好的性能。<lb/>然而，它們的黑箱特性和架構開銷限制了可信度和效率。<lb/>傳統的可解釋人工智慧（XAI）方法依賴於昂貴的迭代過程，只提供輸入層級的過濾，而未解決架構的微調問題。<lb/>為了克服這些限制，本文提出了XAI輔助的遞迴神經網絡通道估計歸因框架（X-RACE）。<lb/>X-RACE使用低複雜度的一次性雙重優化策略，同時評估和修剪無關的輸入子載波和內部隱藏單元。<lb/>此外，我們提出了新穎的時間性XAI指標：飽和時間、重要性漂移和相關性對比，以表徵LSTM的學習動態和記憶收斂。<lb/>大量模擬結果顯示，X-RACE將推斷複雜度降低至少44.1%，同時改善或保持比特錯誤率（BER）性能，超越傳統的XAI方案。
2609.11211.author: Abdul Karim Gizzini et.al.
